system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 13:39 UTC, traffic from 203.0.113.250 reached WS-LMARTINS-01 on RDP port 3389, and the host recorded a remote-interactive (LogonType 10) logon for sam.okafor from that address.
The remote sam.okafor logon received special privileges.
At 13:43 UTC, the domain recorded creation of sysmaint by sam.okafor, followed by adding sysmaint to the Administrators group.

At 13:43 UTC, sam.okafor created a scheduled task on WS-LMARTINS-01 that launches PowerShell with a hidden window and an encoded command. Decoding the command yields an attempt to retrieve and execute a script from http://203.0.113.250/a.ps1.
The scheduled task’s creator logon ID matches the remote sam.okafor logon on WS-LMARTINS-01.

The account-creation and administrator-group events show a different subject logon ID from the recorded remote sam.okafor session, so the available records do not directly tie those domain changes to that workstation logon.

A connection from WS-LMARTINS-01 to the explicit proxy on port 8080 was recorded at 14:06 UTC, but this record does not establish its HTTP request contents or whether the scheduled-task script was retrieved.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy logs were not collected from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC due to a collection outage; proxy activity in that interval cannot be fully reviewed.
The available records show the scheduled task definition but do not show whether it ran or whether its script download succeeded.
The recorded domain account changes use a subject logon ID that does not match the observed remote sam.okafor session.
claims_not_established: Who controlled the remote connection from 203.0.113.250 or whether it was authorized.
Whether sysmaint creation and administrator-group membership were approved, and which session performed those changes.
Whether the scheduled task executed or successfully retrieved and ran the remote script.
What HTTP requests or responses occurred through the proxy during the collection outage.
additional_evidence_needed: Retrieve DC authentication and audit records sufficient to identify the session represented by logon ID 0xcb3d075 and correlate it with the sysmaint changes.
Collect WS-LMARTINS-01 scheduled-task execution history, process and PowerShell logs, and relevant file or memory evidence to determine whether the task ran and what it executed.
Obtain proxy logs, endpoint network telemetry, or packet capture for the 13:30–14:10 UTC interval to investigate the task’s potential download and other web activity.
Verify authorization for the remote RDP access and account changes with the organization, and investigate the source of the connection.
Review and contain the sysmaint account and scheduled task, and assess whether sam.okafor credentials require revocation or reset.
